image_description:
## 1. Chart type
- **Left panel:** Horizontal **stacked bar chart**
- **Right panel:** **Dot plot** / **paired point chart** with two points per country

## 2. Layout techniques
- The visualization uses a **two-panel layout**.
- **Left panel:** bars are **stacked** into three categories (“More,” “Same,” “Less”).
- **Right panel:** countries are listed vertically, with **paired dots** for **men** and **women** on a common horizontal percentage scale.
- No faceting beyond the separation into the two side-by-side panels.

## 3. Data variables

| Data Variable | Type of Variable | Visual Encoding |
|---|---|---|
| Country | Categorical/nominal | Position on y-axis (row order) in both panels; text labels |
| Share with more education than parents | Quantitative | Segment length/position in left stacked horizontal bars; numeric labels |
| Share with same education as parents | Quantitative | Segment length/position in left stacked horizontal bars; numeric labels |
| Share with less education than parents | Quantitative | Segment length/position in left stacked horizontal bars; numeric labels |
| Intergenerational attainment category (“More”, “Same”, “Less”) | Categorical/nominal | Color/hue and stacked bar segment grouping in left panel |
| Share attaining education beyond high school | Quantitative | Horizontal position of dots in right panel; numeric labels for selected points |
| Gender (Men, Women) | Categorical/nominal | Color/hue of dots in right panel |
| Year / reference date (2012, 2014) | Temporal | Panel titles/subtitles (text labels) |
| Age group (25–34 year old) | Ordinal / categorical | Main title text label |
